name: io.github.malithJayasinghe2000/rulewise
title: Rulewise
description: Warns developers which Sri Lankan laws apply to what they build. Legal information, not advice.

tools.name: check_legal_risks
tools.description: Check a planned or new feature for legal risks. Call this whenever the user plans or builds a feature for a product used in Sri Lanka, or made by a Sri Lankan company or person, even if they didn't ask about law. If the user hasn't said where the users or company are, ask them first; never guess the country. Send country codes and facts from get_fact_questions only (no idea text, no code). Returns warnings with severity (Must / Should / Check with a lawyer), the law and section, what to do, and the areas NOT covered.

users_in.description: ISO country codes where users are, as the user said, e.g. ['LK']
users_in.title: Users In

facts.description: List of the facts that are true, from get_fact_questions
facts.title: Facts

company_in.description: ISO country code where the company (or maker) is, e.g. 'LK'
company_in.title: Company In

processing_in.description: ISO country codes where data is stored or processed
processing_in.title: Processing In

done.description: rule_id values of warnings the user says are already handled. Only when the user says so; they are listed as 'done', not verified.
done.title: Done

tools.name: get_fact_questions
tools.description: List the facts check_legal_risks understands, grouped, each with the question it answers. Call once before check_legal_risks.

tools.name: get_rule
tools.description: Get one rule in full, including the exact quote from the law and its official source link. Use it to show proof for a warning.

tools.name: get_checklist
tools.description: Get a law checklist for the product, for example the PDPA 2027 checklist: the rules of that law that apply to these facts, each with what to look for in the code (look_for) or ask the user (ask). Use it when the user asks whether their project is ready for the PDPA. Send country codes and facts only. Mark each item Found (with file and line), Missing or Can't tell from code; never give a score.

users_in.title: Users In

facts.description: List of the facts that are true, from get_fact_questions
facts.title: Facts
